'''Premiere - Virtual Set 3''' is a constructed format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>premiere_set3</code>). Its card pool is Decipher-printed set ids 1&ndash;14 ([[Premiere]] through [[Theed Palace]]) and premium ids 101&ndash;112, plus current Virtual Sets 0&ndash;3 (ids 200&ndash;203) and the Virtual Premium Set (id 301).<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib-ec48dc19" />

== Additional valid cards ==
GEMP also allows 12 cards from later sets:<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="cardjson" /> A Close Race (V), A Useless Gesture, Come Here You Big Coward (V), Crossfire (Endor) (V), Drop! (V), Failure At The Cave (V), Only Jedi Carry That Weapon (V), There Is Another, Thrown Back (V), We'll Let Fate-a Decide, Huh? (V), Yavin Sentry, You've Never Won A Race? (V).

It is not [[Premiere - Original VS3]], the 2002 pool of original Virtual Sets 1&ndash;3.
